reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis contains a physically contradictory mechanism (reduced dislocation density increasing elastic modulus) and relies on an extremely thin, unrealistic simulation cell that cannot capture bulk wear behavior or dislocation substructure evolution.
reasons.testability: The proposed falsification test is circular (it merely repeats the prediction) and does not specify a measurable, independent criterion that would clearly disprove the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it proposes a simulation setup (21 Å coating, 10 m/s indentation) that is physically irrelevant to the high-temperature sliding wear of a real coating, and the predicted mechanism is fundamentally flawed.
